method: Companies where part of the owners hold units of a subsidiary partnership exchangeable one for one into the listed shares. Net income, EPS and equity belong to the listed shares, revenue to the whole group. Like professional data services, P/S counts the market value of shares and units together; P/B counts only the listed shares, because equity excludes the unit holders. Per period, from that period's own 10-K: weighted average units outside the served share count (added for P/S) and units inside it (removed for P/B), as a count of shares on the filing's share basis; later stock splits are applied as to share counts. Listed when units exceed 5% of the share count in some year (project-principles.md, 5.1); a period not listed has no units or fewer than that. Checked 12.11.2026 also for PLD (units already in its diluted count, about 1%), DLR (about 3%), O (about 0.1%) and AVGO 2016 (in the diluted count, about 4%).
